segments.thag10.3:1.1: “Anāgataṃ yo paṭikacca [paṭigacca (sī.)] passati, hitañca atthaṃ ahitañca taṃ dvayaṃ;
segments.thag10.3:1.3: Viddesino tassa hitesino vā, randhaṃ na passanti samekkhamānā.
segments.thag10.3:2.5: Somaṃ lokaṃ pabhāseti, abbhā muttova candimā.
segments.thag10.3:4.3: Paññāya ca alābhena, vittavāpi na jīvati.
segments.thag10.3:5.3: Paññāsahito naro idha, api dukkhesu sukhāni vindati.
segments.thag10.3:6.3: Yattha jāyetha mīyetha, tattha kiṃ viya abbhutaṃ.
segments.thag10.3:7.3: Jātā jātā marantīdha, evaṃdhammā hi pāṇino.
segments.thag10.3:8.1: “Na hetadatthāya matassa hoti, yaṃ jīvitatthaṃ paraporisānaṃ;
segments.thag10.3:8.3: Matamhi ruṇṇaṃ na yaso na lokyaṃ, na vaṇṇitaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇehi.
segments.thag10.3:9.1: “Cakkhuṃ sarīraṃ upahanti tena [upahanti ruṇṇaṃ (sī.), upahanti roṇṇaṃ (syā. pī.)], nihīyati vaṇṇabalaṃ matī ca;
segments.thag10.3:9.3: Ānandino tassa disā bhavanti, hitesino nāssa sukhī bhavanti.
segments.thag10.3:10.1: “Tasmā hi iccheyya kule vasante, medhāvino ceva bahussute ca;
segments.thag10.3:10.3: Yesaṃ hi paññāvibhavena kiccaṃ, taranti nāvāya nadiṃva puṇṇan”ti.

lines: Na kevalameteva ye rudato ādīnavā, atha kho imepīti dassento “cakkhuṃ sarīraṃ upahantī”ti gāthaṃ vatvā tato paraṃ sokādianatthapaṭibāhanatthaṃ kalyāṇamittapayirupāsanāyaṃ tā niyojento “tasmā”tiādinā osānagāthamāha.

Tattha tasmāti yasmā ruṇṇaṃ rudantassa puggalassa cakkhuṃ sarīrañca upahanti vibādhati, tena ruṇṇena vaṇṇo balaṃ mati ca nihīyati parihāyati, tassa rudantassa puggalassa disā sapattā ānandino pamodavanto pītivanto bhavanti.

Hitesino mittā dukkhī dukkhitā bhavanti tasmā dhammojapaññāya samannāgatattā medhāvino diṭṭhadhammikādiatthasannissitassa bāhusaccassa pāripūriyā bahussute, attano kule vasante iccheyya pāṭikaṅkheyya kulūpake kareyya.
Yesanti yesaṃ medhāvīnaṃ bahussutānaṃ paṇḍitānaṃ paññāvibhavena paññābalena yathā mahoghassa puṇṇaṃ nadiṃ nāvāya taranti, evaṃ kulaputtā attano atthakiccaṃ taranti pāraṃ pāpuṇanti.
